purpose: Separate teacher post-training from the lightweight student transfer branch.
alt: The Qwen3 report separates a four-stage large-model path, including cold start, reasoning RL, thinking-mode fusion and general RL, from a lightweight-model distillation branch. Teacher capability is transferred through off-policy responses and on-policy feedback rather than requiring every student to repeat the large-model path.
caption: **Figure 1.** Teacher training and student training are distinct paths. Qwen Team, original report Figure 1; attributed figure-region excerpt for analysis.[^qwen3][^qwen-figure]

purpose: Inspect the hybrid visual route and adaptive logit-difference loss together.
alt: Switch-KD has a standard student-versus-teacher output path and a hybrid path from the student visual encoder through the frozen teacher projector and language model. Its DBiLD loss selects informative regions of teacher and student logit curves using adaptive knee points, then compares pairwise logit differences in both directions.
caption: **Figure 2.** Visual features are tested through language predictions. Sun et al., Switch-KD v1, original Figure 2; complete figure-region excerpt for analysis.[^switch-kd][^figures]
